milestone: ATTR48: ordinary global-file HaltCompiler Tick emission
status: Independently accepted bounded implementation; wider source/lifetime and full-core obligations remain partial
target: PHP 8.5.10 CLI NTS 64-bit; project-local binary and tests/semantics/profile.json

production.scope: One four-line Halt summary retains LAST/frequency and uses the checked end line with existing positive halt-end/offset facts. Generic statement emission and the existing authenticated raw Halt consumer provide execution. No producer, constant consumer, work-stream, runtime, machine or schema changes.

authority.compiler: zend_compile_halt_compiler only registers the mangled file offset constant, emits no opcode and does not retime CG(zend_lineno). HALT_COMPILER is not unticked, so compile_stmt can emit its trailing Tick subject to adjacency. The parser creates the HALT AST/offset zval after consuming the terminator, supplying its end line.
authority.existing_facts: pphalt_valid, pphalt_end/offset and the raw Halt STMT already authenticate terminal/source position and offset availability. Remaining payload bytes are represented as data, not executable statements.

native_author_first.scope: Uncalled method enables ticks with no prior marker: Halt dispatches T. A prior real Tick suppresses the Halt marker, still giving T. Both keep BAD payload inert; native-only preparation carries no differential credit.

author_sources.scope: The two originals discriminate emission from unconditional or duplicated Halt callbacks, with no payload execution.

independent_source.scope: Keyword line16 differs from terminator19. Callback traces19 and reads the existing dynamic offset constant410, then throws through exception handler C and shutdown Z. BAD payload is never executed.

independent_reached.count_note: Reported conditions include helper bindings, not only independent assertions.
independent_reached.scope: At the genuine Halt marker, line19/frequency1, exact retained payload and offset410 validate before callback. One step produces canonical TICK_NEXT receipt; zero-budget and one-step/full-resume equality pass. Final normal T19:410CZ, heap/descriptors/Tick validity and inert payload hold.

independent_review: Peer traced the parser/compiler line and opcode path, reviewed the exact clause against existing terminal/offset authority and accepted the actual marker/dispatch/budget front after one payload-expectation fixture correction. No production/source change was required.
remaining: Witnesses cover ordinary global files and existing offset consumers. Wider source modes, namespace/encoding cases, owning callbacks and lifetime combinations remain partial; no whole halt/tick family closure is claimed.
environment: Original bytes, paths/cwd, commands, raw channels/exits and implementation/tool fingerprints remain external in tick-halt-48. Sources use LC_ALL=C, TZ=UTC, PATH=/usr/bin:/bin and the pinned profile. Checked SL uses CPU 5, disabled caches and encountered determinism checks. All accepted inputs were stable with exit 0/empty driver stderr; all campaign executables were reaped. Regular local tools were preserved from idle ATTR47; no fresh build/portability claim.
